item.title: Google Street View Captured Her Car After She Vanished
item.description: Arelie Garcia, 25, disappeared from Salinas, California, on September 22, 2022. Her car was found in Big Sur with her phone and wallet inside—and appeared in a Google Street View image taken that day. She remains missing, and police continue investigating.

item.title: He Lured A Stranger To Frame For His Wife’s Murder
item.description: Brendan Banfield and his au pair posed as his wife online to lure Joseph Ryan into a deadly setup at their Virginia home in 2023. After the au pair testified, Banfield was convicted of murdering Ryan and Christine Banfield. He received life without parole and has filed an appeal.

item.title: He Texted His Mistress About Killing His Wife
item.description: Former American Idol contestant Caleb Flynn’s mistress read jurors messages in which he discussed killing his wife, Ashley. Prosecutors said he staged a break-in after her February 2026 murder in Ohio. He was convicted and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: He Said He Was Asleep. His Devices Told Another Story
item.description: Caleb Flynn blamed an intruder for his wife Ashley’s February 2026 murder in Ohio. Investigators testified that device activity contradicted his account of being asleep. The former American Idol contestant was convicted and sentenced to life without parole.

item.title: Police Said She Confessed. The Recording Was Inaudible.
item.description: Steven Freeman, 23, died after his girlfriend, Mary Katherine Higdon, shot him in their Georgia home in 2018. Police said she confessed to murder, but audio interference obscured the recording. Her defense argued self-defense, and a jury acquitted her of all charges in 2019.

item.title: Her Last Call To Her Sister Was From Walmart
item.description: Caitlin Denison, 19, called her sister from a Midland, Texas, Walmart in January 2018, saying she feared for her life after traveling there with a man. Her sister recalls that final conversation as Texas Rangers continue investigating her unresolved disappearance.

item.title: He Spent 37 Hours Covering Up Her Murder
item.description: Christine Holloway, 43, was killed in Ansonia, Connecticut, in December 2019. Trial evidence showed Jose Morales spent 37 hours cleaning up and destroying evidence. He received 65 years for murder and evidence tampering in 2025. Their daughter Vanessa, then 14 months old, remains missing.

item.title: She Called 911 About An Intruder Her Husband Invented
item.description: Heidi Firkus, 25, was shot during a 911 call in St. Paul in 2010. Her husband Nicholas blamed an intruder, but investigators uncovered an eviction scheduled for the next day that he had concealed from her. Convicted of murder in 2023, he received life without parole; his conviction was upheld in 2026.
